We’ve teamed up with Black Rooster Audio to give one BPB reader a free license for OmniTec-436C , a vintage-style vari-mu compressor for macOS and Windows.

We previously featured OmniTec-436C in a discounted offer , but this time there’s a license up for grabs. The winner will receive a single-use eCoupon to redeem in their Black Rooster Audio account, which generates their own license and serial number.

OmniTec-436C is inspired by the Altec 436C tube compressor. Black Rooster Audio models the vari-mu gain stage and tube makeup amplifier, then adds controls for shaping how the compressor responds to your track.

You won’t find a Ratio knob here. Compression follows a program-dependent curve, so you adjust the Input and Threshold to control how much it compresses. Comp mode provides a softer response, while Lim mode applies firmer peak control. Makeup brings the level back up afterward.

title: Song Athletics 将 OSS 一键采样插件免费
titleEn: Song Athletics makes OSS one-shot sampler plugin FREE
summary: Song Athletics has made OSS, its one-shot sampler plugin for macOS and Windows, available for free, including an update adding random sample selection and dela…
content:
Song Athletics has made OSS , its one-shot sampler plugin for macOS and Windows, available for free, including an update adding random sample selection and delay effects.

OSS was originally priced at £10, and it comes with a demo pack of the developer’s one-shot samples and background images. You can start with those sounds or, if you already have some samples to work with, point it at a folder from your own collection.

If you’re wondering what the plugin actually does, I guess it’s enough to say that OSS stands for One Shot Sampler. It maps a single sample across the keyboard so you can play it as an instrument. This means you can load a sampled synth note, for example, and use it to play a melody or chord progression.

You can then move through the other samples in the folder while continuing to play. So, it’s an easy way to hear how the same musical idea works with different sounds, much like browsing presets on a synth.

That also gives you a fun way to explore folders you already own. Instead of judging a sample by hearing it once at its original pitch, you can try it across different notes and hear what happens when you play several at once.

The latest update added a dice button that adds random selection to that process. Click it to choose another sample and carry on playing, without having to work through the folder in order.

summary: Golden DSP is giving ten BPB readers a free copy of Pyrosphere, a phase dispersion effect for macOS and Windows that combines transient shaping, distortion, an…
content:
Golden DSP is giving ten BPB readers a free copy of Pyrosphere , a phase dispersion effect for macOS and Windows that combines transient shaping, distortion, and compression.

In addition to our exclusive giveaway, Pyrosphere includes an early Black Friday launch offer that cuts the price from $79 to $29.

By the way, we previously teamed up with Golden DSP for a Silkbrush Reverb giveaway (congrats again to all the winners in that one!).

This new plugin focuses on reshaping transients and getting more experimental with sound design.

Pyrosphere lets you spread different parts of a sound out in time, so for example, you can turn up the Disperse section on a drum hit to stretch its attack into a sweep or a laser-like zap. Lower settings are intended for subtler changes to the sound’s weight and attack.

The Reverse section works in the opposite direction. Both sections let you choose where in the frequency spectrum the processing happens, and you can link them or set them differently.

You can make the sound grittier with five Drive modes, including tape, tube, and wavefolding. The Comp fader adjusts several compressor settings together, so pulling it down changes the threshold, ratio, and timing at the same time.

Auto Level matches the processed volume to the dry signal for comparison, while the Safety soft clipper keeps peaks under a -0.1 dBFS ceiling. The Mix knob lets you blend the result with your original audio.

content:
Polyend is offering Patch , a sample pack featuring 101 experimental Eurorack effects, for free with the code PROMOPATCH at checkout.

Simply add the pack to your cart and apply the code before completing checkout. Thanks to BPB reader Stan for the info!

The collection is great for a bit of weekend inspiration if you like sounds that sit somewhere between electronic music and cinematic sound design. You’ll find a wide variety of modular sounds, including chaotic noises, deep tones, impacts, and more, organized into dedicated folders.

You can use those movements to connect sections of a track, drop an impact at the end of a transition, or even load some of these in a sampler and play them like instruments. The product page has five audio demos if you want to hear what’s included.

I’ve said this before, including when we covered Polyend’s Bliss Chords , but I appreciate simple sample packs more and more.

My inbox is drowning every day in an avalanche of AI-made VST plugins with bombastic marketing that doesn’t make any sense. Getting something simple and inspirational like this is a breath of fresh air on a Saturday morning.

Created by Polyend Sound Design, Patch contains 101 one-shot samples in stereo at 44.1 kHz and 24-bit resolution.

title: Vibe Together：可免费试玩的音乐创作多人游戏
titleEn: Vibe Together turns music-making into a multiplayer game you can try for FREE
summary: Vibe Together is a free-to-start browser music sandbox where up to eight people can build a song together on a shared grid. A Steam edition is coming later, an…
content:
Vibe Together is a free-to-start browser music sandbox where up to eight people can build a song together on a shared grid.

A Steam edition is coming later, and you can wishlist Vibe Together on Steam .

Developed by The Music Unc, Vibe Together has been four years in the making. The idea behind the project is to make creating music feel more like playing a game with friends, and I think it looks awesome.

In Vibe Together, you place musical objects on the grid, connect them with wires, and watch signals travel between them to trigger sounds. The distance between objects determines the timing, so moving a note changes when you hear it. Pitch is represented by color, letting you follow a melody visually as it plays.

You can build a repeating loop or give different branches a chance of playing, so the pattern changes as it goes around. The procedural music system uses your key, scale, and chord progression to generate notes, with editable rules for how melodies move and resolve.

For example, set a rhythm branch to play 70% of the time, and it won’t appear on every pass. You can keep rearranging the connections while the music plays and hear how each change affects the result.

You can simply invite friends through a session link, and everyone can work on the same composition at once. The whole setup can work like an online multiplayer band, where one person can build the drums while another adds a bassline, etc.

UJAM 推出了一款超级锯齿波合成器：Detunicorn，该插件可生成适用于 Hyperpop、Digicore 和 Dance Pop 的厚重超级锯齿波和弦与 Stab 音色。

Detunicorn 的声音灵感来自 Roland JP-8000 和 Nord Lead 等设备的超级锯齿波音色，并通过更密集的叠层和处理进一步强化。插件配备两个超级锯齿波振荡器和一个子振荡器，最多可叠加四层齐奏，并可进行失谐和立体声扩展。

Detunicorn 采用一组简洁的专用参数塑造大型和弦和 Stab 音色。Unison 用于调节叠层数量，Detune 用于增加各层之间的变化，Sub 用于调节低频成分。Bend 可设置八度音高包络的衰减时间，Bite 可增强高频表现，Infinity 则提供专为该插件设计的大型空间混响。

Detunicorn 功能特点：

Detunicorn 支持 Windows 和 macOS 系统，支持 M 系列处理器，插件格式为 VST、VST3、AU 和 AAX。Detunicorn 现可免费获取，活动截至 2026 年 11 月 18 日。
